posts.text: Did you know that 40 Mississippi highway patrolmen shot 460 rounds into this building on the Jackson State campus in 1970? They k*lled Phillip Gibbs and James Earl Green, as well as injuring 12 others.  No police officers were charged or convicted in the shooting. An all white grand jury declined any indictment, stating the police were justified.  #hbcu #history #jsu #jacksonstate #theeilove
posts.summary: Condemns unpunished police violence against Black students
